title: SSC MTS / Havaldar Result 2026 – Out

shortDescription: SSC has declared SSC MTS / Havaldar Result 2026. Check merit list and cutoff at ssc.gov.in.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the SSC MTS / Havaldar Result 2026.

Candidates who appeared in the Computer Based Examination can check their result / scorecard and category-wise cutoff on the official SSC website.

How to check

  • Visit ssc.gov.in
  • Open Results → MTS / Havaldar
  • Download the result PDF or check score login as notified

Keep registration credentials ready and follow further instructions for document verification if shortlisted.
